$comment: Second source for the sundays block (L-065, 011 amendment 5): OLM 1981 for every reading imported from LitCal, in OLM numbering (Vulgate psalms; lectionary:crosscheck converts them). `canonical` is given by hand where convert.ts cannot convert (Sirach; Vulgate Ps 115 and 147, which the Nova Vulgata numbers from verse 10 and 12). The OLM citations were entered from the OLM 1981 structure as the agent knows it, before comparison; no print copy was consulted (011 Q4). LitCal has no data for the OLM-filled readings (Years B and C) at the pinned revision; `consulted` records the leaves checked, and those readings are listed as single-source in disputes/sundays.md.
